# HANEEN KARMANJI — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> HANEEN KARMANJI is a high-end feminine fashion and beauty brand that blends style, quality, and a sense of luxury into a cohesive boutique experience. The brand exudes softness, elegance, and modernity, offering curated collections across jewelry, bags, clothing, perfumes, and skincare. The visual identity is rooted in a minimalist, clean aesthetic with a warm palette of beige, white, soft pink, and gold accents — evoking a premium luxury boutique atmosphere. The website is designed in Hebrew (RTL) and targets women who appreciate refined, elegant style and a seamless, premium online shopping experience.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About HANEEN KARMANJI
HANEEN KARMANJI is a high-end feminine fashion and beauty brand that blends style, quality, and a sense of luxury into a cohesive boutique experience. The brand exudes softness, elegance, and modernity, offering curated collections across jewelry, bags, clothing, perfumes, and skincare. The visual identity is rooted in a minimalist, clean aesthetic with a warm palette of beige, white, soft pink, and gold accents — evoking a premium luxury boutique atmosphere. The website is designed in Hebrew (RTL) and targets women who appreciate refined, elegant style and a seamless, premium online shopping experience.

## Services/Products
- תכשיטים (Jewelry)
- תיקים (Bags)
- בגדים (Clothing)
- בשמים (Perfumes)
- מוצרי טיפוח ויופי (Beauty & Skincare)

## Target Audience
- Women seeking luxury, elegant fashion and beauty products
- נשים המחפשות אופנה יוקרתית
- משפיעניות אופנה ובלוגריות
- נשים קרייריסטיות במטרופולין

## Industry
Fashion & Beauty
